review_candidates.title: Ai ML Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description elämä.ai is dedicated to infusing life into technology to help build a better future. The company focuses on creating intelligent, human-centered solutions that leverage AI and machine learning to solve real-world problems. Team members collaborate across disciplines to design and deliver products that are both technically robust and socially impactful. elämä.ai values innovation, continuous learning, and ethical use of technology, offering a dynamic environment for professionals who want to contribute to meaningful, future-oriented work. Role Description This full-time, on-site Ai ML Engineer role is based in Heliopolis and focuses on designing, developing, and deploying machine learning and AI models into production systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting and preprocessing data, experimenting with different algorithms, optimizing model performance, and validating results against business and user needs. The Ai ML Engineer will work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate models into applications, monitor performance, and iterate on solutions. The role also involves documenting technical work, participating in code reviews, and staying current with advances in AI and ML to recommend improvements and new approaches. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in machine learning model development, including familiarity with supervised and unsupervised learning techniques and practical experience with model evaluation and optimization. Candidates should possess strong skills in programming and software engineering, such as proficiency in Python or similar languages, experience with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch), and solid understanding of version control and testing practices. Candidates should possess strong skills in data handling and analysis, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, and working with structured and unstructured data using tools like SQL and common data libraries. Candidates should possess strong skills in system integration and deployment, including experience with APIs, cloud platforms or containerization, and monitoring model performance in production environments. Candidates should possess strong skills in analytical thinking and problem solving, with the ability to translate complex challenges into clear technical tasks and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Relevant qualifications include a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in AI/ML roles. Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with MLOps practices, experience working in cross-functional product teams, and an interest in ethical and responsible AI development.

review_candidates.title: Senior Graphic Designer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Verutti Millano is an Italian luxury brand founded in 2022, specializing in high-end watches, eyewear, and leather accessories. The company blends classic Italian elegance with contemporary design to create distinctive fashion pieces. Verutti focuses on craftsmanship, precision, and style, offering products that elevate everyday looks. Its mission is to design accessories that express confidence, individuality, and a refined lifestyle. Team members join a growing brand committed to quality, innovation, and strong visual identity. Role Description The Senior Graphic Designer is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the visual design and brand expression of Verutti Millano across digital and print channels. Day-to-day tasks include developing brand-aligned concepts, creating marketing and campaign assets, designing product-focused visuals, and refining layouts for web, social media, and advertising. The role involves collaborating with marketing, product, and leadership teams to maintain a cohesive brand identity, as well as preparing production-ready files and design guidelines. The Senior Graphic Designer will also mentor junior designers, provide creative direction, and ensure design quality and consistency across all touchpoints. Qualifications Strong visual design capabilities, including Graphics and Graphic Design skills. Brand development expertise, including Logo Design and Branding skills. Advanced understanding of Typography and its application across digital and print media. Proficiency with industry-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, XD or similar). Experience creating visual systems for luxury, fashion, or lifestyle brands is highly beneficial. Ability to translate brand strategy into compelling visual concepts and campaigns. Excellent attention to detail, layout precision, and visual consistency. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in remote, cross-functional teams. Portfolio demonstrating senior-level design work, brand systems, and digital campaign assets. Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
